cases.title: Home page shows Oman key figures
cases.expected: Page loads with leading platform, internet users and population

cases.title: Switch the interface to Arabic
cases.expected: Page uses right-to-left layout and Arabic text
cases.actual: dir=rtl, RTL stylesheet and Arabic menu loaded

cases.title: Default time series for Oman
cases.expected: 24 monthly values for every platform with data

cases.title: 3-month moving average
cases.expected: Each smoothed value equals the mean of that month and the two before

cases.title: Yearly World Bank indicator
cases.expected: Labels are years and the device filter is ignored

cases.title: Compare countries is limited to six
cases.expected: Only the first 6 countries are returned

cases.title: Map of the leading platform
cases.expected: Every country with data gets a colour; Worldwide is not drawn

cases.title: Unknown statistic type
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with an error message

cases.title: Unknown device value
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with an error message

cases.title: Unknown country code in the link
cases.expected: The page falls back to the default country (Oman)

cases.title: Script injected in a URL parameter (XSS)
cases.expected: Invalid value is ignored and never reaches the page
cases.actual: invalid period ignored, default period used; no script in the page

cases.title: Filter results by age group and gender
cases.expected: Numbers and charts change to the filtered group

cases.title: Favourite platform not among used platforms
cases.expected: Rejected with a clear message

cases.title: Submit without ticking consent
cases.expected: Rejected; asks for consent

cases.title: Valid questionnaire answer
cases.expected: Saved, then redirected to the results

cases.title: Second answer from the same session
cases.expected: Refused; count does not change

cases.title: Hidden honeypot field filled by a bot
cases.expected: Answer silently discarded

cases.title: Open an admin page without signing in
cases.expected: Redirected to the sign-in page

cases.title: Sign in with a wrong password
cases.expected: Generic error; attempt written to the audit log
cases.actual: error shown, 1 failed attempt(s) in audit log

cases.title: Five wrong passwords in a row
cases.expected: Account locked for 15 minutes, even for the right password
cases.actual: 6th attempt with the right password refused: account locked 15 min

cases.title: Form sent without CSRF token
cases.expected: Request refused with HTTP 403
cases.actual: HTTP 403: The form has expired. Go back, reload th...

cases.title: Sign in with correct details
cases.expected: Dashboard opens; session id renewed

cases.title: Data editor opens an administrator page
cases.expected: Audit log refused (403); editor pages allowed
cases.actual: audit log HTTP 403, update page HTTP 200

cases.title: Upload a .txt file
cases.expected: File rejected before it is stored

cases.title: Excel file with two bad rows
cases.expected: Preview lists valid rows and explains each error
cases.actual: preview: 2 valid rows, 2 errors with row numbers; cancelled

cases.title: Save an import, then undo it
cases.expected: Rows are saved, and undo removes all of them
cases.actual: import #11: 2 rows saved, 0 left after undo

cases.title: StatCounter CSV with empty future months
cases.expected: Months where every value is 0 are skipped

cases.title: Download a full database backup
cases.expected: File contains every table and the same number of rows
cases.actual: 1921 KB, all 11 tables, 21596 data rows match

cases.title: Open private folders in the browser
cases.expected: includes/, storage/ and database/ return 403

cases.title: Update from the World Bank API
cases.expected: Request succeeds; values updated; date recorded
cases.actual: 0 new values, 0 updated, 0 requests failed in 4 s
